description: This file defines a utility enum 'CaptureRateLimits' that provides static methods to clamp duration in milliseconds and frames per second (FPS) within specified bounds.

methods.name: clampDurationMs
methods.description: Clamps a given duration in milliseconds to be within minMs and maxMs, using defaultMs if input is nil.

methods.name: clampFps
methods.description: Clamps a given FPS value to be within minFps and maxFps, using defaultFps if input is nil. Handles non-finite values gracefully.
